rules.name: Explicit change
rules.body: Before/after labels identify maintained instructions without relying on color. Violet carries action and relevance.

dos: Do connect evidence to relief from manual instruction upkeep and timely agent lookup.
Do use semantic palette variables for all themes and state text alongside color.
Do retain wrapping commands and stable, native keyboard behavior.
donts: Don't imply the website runs Tuna, analyzes input, or collects real conversations.
Don't add eyebrow headings, gradient text, generic icon-card grids, or decorative charts.
